request: Order ORD-1012 still hasn't shipped and the customer is asking. What went wrong and what should we do?

steps.text: I’m going to pull the order details first to see its status, promised delivery date, items, and fulfillment warehouse.
I will check stock for SKU-101 at WH-CHI to see if a shortage at the fulfillment warehouse is preventing shipment.
I will search other warehouses for 10 units of SKU-101 to see if a single warehouse can cover the shortfall for a transfer.

arguments.summary: The order is past its promised delivery date and has not shipped because the fulfillment warehouse (WH-CHI) only has 20 of the 30 units required for SKU-101. A 10‑unit shortfall is preventing dispatch.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1012 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT at WH-CHI, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-15, ship_by_date 2026-03-12, is_past_promised_date true.
check_inventory: SKU-101 at WH-CHI on_hand 20, reserved 0, available 20 (ordered 30).
find_alternative_stock: SKU-101 required_quantity 10; WH-BOS available 35 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-DAL available 15 can_cover_required_quantity true.
arguments.likely_cause: Inventory shortfall at WH-CHI (available 20 vs ordered 30) prevented shipment before the promised date.
uncertainties: Inter-warehouse transfer lead time from WH-BOS or WH-DAL to WH-CHI.
Whether the customer will accept a partial shipment of 20 units now.
Any pending inbound replenishment ETA for SKU-101 to WH-CHI.

recommended_actions.details: Transfer 10 units of SKU-101 from WH-BOS to WH-CHI to cover the shortfall and complete the order; justified by find_alternative_stock showing WH-BOS available 35 and can_cover_required_quantity true for 10.
Ship 20 units of SKU-101 from WH-CHI immediately to reduce customer impact; justified by check_inventory showing available 20 at WH-CHI vs ordered 30.

Inform the customer that the order missed the 2026-03-15 promise due to a 10-unit shortage at WH-CHI and provide the plan/ETA: 20 units ship now and remaining 10 after transfer from WH-BOS; supported by get_order_details (is_past_promised_date true) and check_inventory (available 20 of 30).

arguments.recommendation: Transfer 10 units of SKU-101 from WH-BOS to WH-CHI, ship the 20 units available at WH-CHI now, and notify the customer of the plan and updated ETA.
missing_information: Exact transfer transit time from WH-BOS to WH-CHI
Any pending inbound PO/ETA to WH-CHI for SKU-101
